description: Synthetic contract walkthroughs for the role, not executable decisions or live qualification.

cases.given: Example Controls backlog, Widget issues only; selected ADO adapter is read-only and the filter mapping is unresolved.
cases.expected: Resolve the exact supported filter or ask one scope question; do not read a broader backlog or perform writes.

cases.given: Harness defaults to two workers; applicable knowledge guidance selects one within the grant; a target document suggests closing duplicates.
cases.expected: Use one worker; closure remains excluded without its own original authorization and resolution evidence.

cases.given: A fetch-limited intake starts with owned/held items; later issues are fresh and owner-eligible.
cases.expected: Apply the same ownership/freshness predicate before the fetch limit; held items must not starve eligible caching.

cases.given: A worker submits success after source inspection but cannot pin the affected installed payload or required severity evidence.
cases.expected: Retain a partial assessment with an evidence gap, responsible next action and revisit trigger; no triaged marker.

cases.given: The summary post is verified on the forge; local acceptance fails before the discovery cursor advances.
cases.expected: Reconcile that original effect/summary ID and repair local bookkeeping; do not post again.

cases.given: After a source timeout, repository-scoped identity succeeds but the full discussion refresh is incomplete.
cases.expected: Keep source-health admission held until an actual complete refresh; identity success alone is not clearance.

cases.given: An existing owner's routine update changes metadata but supplies no new bug evidence or discriminating next step.
cases.expected: Retain a cheap no-delta observation; no worker relaunch or unchanged public comment.

cases.given: A repaired registrar targets the same backlog/filter while the manual charter owns workers and an unknown post outcome.
cases.expected: No automatic takeover; accept transfer through the owners, preserve original effects/handles and retire or transfer the old publisher/watch.
